title: How we keep your demo safe
intro: A demo is a way to try our software without risk. This page says plainly how demo links work, what we record about your visit, and what we do and do not yet have in place.

items.label: Made for you, for one product
items.text: Each link is created for one customer and opens one product's demo only. It does not work on any other product.

items.label: It expires, and we can end it at once
items.text: A link works for a set time, never longer than 30 days. We can switch it off at any moment, and connections you already have open are closed within seconds.

items.label: Not guessable, and not readable by us
items.text: The link contains a long random code. We store only a one-way scrambled copy of it, so our own records cannot be used to recover your link.

items.label: Previews do not open it
items.text: Mail programs and chat apps often fetch links to show a preview. That does not open your demo or use up the link: you press a button to start.

items.label: Limits when needed
items.text: A link can be set to open only a certain number of times, or to work only in the first browser that opens it.

items.label: Sample data only
items.text: Demos run on made-up sample data, in copies that are kept apart from our real applications and their databases.

items.label: Private or shared, and we tell you which
items.text: For products that support it, you get your own private copy, started when you open the link and deleted when it ends. Other demos are shared: other visitors may be in them, and they are put back to their starting data afterwards. Before you enter, the page tells you which kind it is.

items.label: Please keep it fictional
items.text: Do not type real personal, customer or confidential information into a demo. We say this on the page before you open it.

sections.title: What we record about your visit

items.label: When you open the link
items.text: We note the time, your network address and your browser type when a link is opened or refused. These records are deleted after 90 days.

items.label: How the demo is used
items.text: Per day we count how many requests were made, how long you were active, and which pages were used most (the first part of the address only). So we can see whether the demo helped, not what you did in it.

items.label: What we do not record here
items.text: Anything you type into the demo itself, passwords, search words or other details that follow a page address, and the files and images a page loads.

items.label: You are told first
items.text: The page you see before opening a demo says what is recorded.

items.label: Deletion on request
items.text: Ask us and we delete the records of your link and remove your name from it.

items.label: Only on some links, and you are told first
items.text: Some links include a chat guide beside the demo. It is off unless we switch it on for your link, and the page you see before you open the demo tells you if it is there.

items.label: It is an AI, and your words go to Anthropic
items.text: The guide is an AI assistant, not a person. What you type to it is sent to Anthropic, the company that runs the AI, to get an answer. The page before the demo and the guide itself both say this.

items.label: We do not keep what you type
items.text: Your questions and its answers are not saved in our database or our logs. The last few are held in memory only while your visit lasts, and are dropped after 2 hours without use, so the guide can follow the conversation. We keep only counts: how many messages, and what they cost.

items.label: It cannot see or change anything
items.text: The guide cannot see your screen or the demo's data, cannot click or change anything, and knows only the product notes we wrote for it. Its answers are shown as plain text, never as web page code.

items.label: It has limits
items.text: Each link has its own message allowance. A message can be at most 500 characters, only a few can be sent per minute, and a daily spending limit applies across all links.

items.label: Your session is separate from the link
items.text: After you open the link your browser gets a different random code, kept out of reach of page scripts. The link itself is never used again, so it cannot be copied out of your browser's cookies.

items.label: Guessing and flooding are slowed down
items.text: Repeated wrong links, or far too many requests from one address, are blocked for a while.

items.label: Secure connections
items.text: The demo service is built to run over HTTPS: its cookies are marked secure and browsers are told to always use HTTPS for it. Its own pages cannot be shown inside other websites.

items.label: Switched-off access stays off
items.text: Every request is checked against your link again, so an expired or ended link stops working immediately, not at the next sign-in.

items.label: Owner-only console
items.text: Links are created and ended in a console that only we can reach. It is protected by a password and a second code from an authenticator app, limits sign-in attempts, and signs us out after 12 hours.

items.label: Every change is logged
items.text: Sign-ins, failed sign-ins and the creation and ending of links are written to an activity log.

items.label: Backups
items.text: The database that holds links and records is copied automatically about once a day, and recent copies are kept.

items.label: Automated tests
items.text: A large set of automated tests runs on every change to the code.

items.label: Written reviews
items.text: We review our own code for security problems in writing, keep each finding, and fix them. The reviews and fixes are kept in the project's history.

notYet.title: What we do not have yet
notYet.text: We have not had an independent penetration test, and we hold no formal certification such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001. If your purchasing process needs either, tell us. The AI guide can also be wrong: treat its answers as hints, and check anything important with us.

report.title: Found a problem, or have a question?
report.text: Tell us what you saw and how to reproduce it. We read every message.
